span.label: mechanisms
span.term: recast posterior inference as optimization: choose the distribution in a simple (mean-field) family that is closest in KL divergence to the true posterior, via coordinate ascent
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: VI has been studied less rigorously than MCMC and its statistical properties are less well understood
span.note: what this limits: any statistical guarantee: Quotation withheld AND ITS STATISTICAL PROPERTIES ARE LESS WELL UNDERSTOOD
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The authors state that variational inference is not yet theoretically well understood.
span.note: what this limits: any guarantee about a variational solution: VI IS POWERFUL, BUT IT IS NOT YET WELL UNDERSTOOD
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper's comparison against MCMC is not definitive; other samplers might perform better.
span.note: what this limits: the paper's own VI-versus-MCMC comparison: THIS IS NOT A DEFINITIVE COMPARISON BETWEEN VARIATIONAL INFERENCE AND MCMC
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Collapsed variational inference is explicitly excluded from the review's scope.
span.note: what this limits: the review's coverage of collapsed variational inference and related speed-ups: THESE IDEAS ARE OUTSIDE THE SCOPE OF OUR REVIEW
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The review deliberately restricts itself to the mean-field family, excluding richer variational families.
span.note: what this limits: every result in the review, which assumes independence: IN THIS REVIEW WE FOCUS ON THE MEAN-FIELD VARIATIONAL FAMILY, WHERE THE LATENT VARIABLES ARE MUTUALLY INDEPENDENT AND EACH GOVERNED BY A DISTINCT FACTOR IN THE VARIATIONAL DENSITY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Collapsed variational inference and related speed-ups are excluded from the review's coverage.
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[3] · what this limits: the same scope as item 3 - collapsed VI is excluded, so the review is not a survey of what is fastest in practice
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The survey of applications is not exhaustive.
span.note: what this limits: the survey of applications: THIS DISCUSSION IS NOT EXHAUSTIVE; OUR INTENTION IS TO OUTLINE THE DIVERSITY OF APPLICATIONS OF VARIATIONAL INFERENCE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The accuracy of variational inference relative to MCMC is not known, and VI is known to underestimate posterior variance.
span.note: what this limits: any accuracy claim against MCMC: THE RELATIVE ACCURACY OF VARIATIONAL INFERENCE AND MCMC IS STILL UNKNOWN
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Variational inference systematically underestimates posterior variance because of its objective function.
span.note: what this limits: any use of the posterior variance, with the direction and the cause: VARIATIONAL INFERENCE GENERALLY UNDERESTIMATES THE VARIANCE OF THE POSTERIOR DENSITY; THIS IS A CONSEQUENCE OF ITS OBJECTIVE FUNCTION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper's empirical CAVI-versus-Hamiltonian-Monte-Carlo timing comparison is not a definitive comparison of the two paradigms.
span.note: what this limits: the empirical timing comparison: OTHER SAMPLERS, SUCH AS A COLLAPSED GIBBS SAMPLER, MAY PERFORM BETTER THAN HAMILTONIAN MONTE CARLO SAMPLING
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The statistical theory of variational inference remains undeveloped, which the paper flags as an open problem rather than something it settles.
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 0: THE STATISTICAL PROPERTIES OF VARIATIONAL INFERENCE ARE NOT YET WELL UNDERSTOOD, ESPECIALLY IN CONTRAST TO THE WEALTH OF ANALYSIS OF MCMC TECHNIQUES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The review states that its own subject is not yet well understood, and that its statistical properties have been studied less rigorously than the alternative it is compared to.
span.note: what this limits: choosing variational inference on the strength of its literature: the review states it has been studied less rigorously than MCMC and that its statistical properties are less well understood
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The defect is known, directional, and declared possibly acceptable — the acceptability depending on the task rather than on the method.
span.note: what this limits: any posterior variance, credible interval or uncertainty estimate taken from a variational posterior: the review states VI generally underestimates posterior variance as a consequence of its objective function, and that whether this is acceptable depends on the task
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: How accurate the method is relative to the alternative is stated to be unknown.
span.note: what this limits: a claim that variational inference is or is not as accurate as MCMC for a given problem: the review states the relative accuracy is still unknown
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The objective actually optimised is a substitute for the one wanted, adopted because the wanted one cannot be computed.
span.note: what this limits: reading an ELBO value as a measure of divergence from the posterior: the review states the KL cannot be computed and that the ELBO is an alternative objective equal to it up to an added constant
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The optimisation reaches a local optimum only, the objective is generally non-convex, and different initialisations were observed to reach different values.
span.note: what this limits: a single variational fit as THE variational approximation: the review states the ELBO is generally non-convex, that CAVI guarantees only a local optimum sensitive to initialisation, and that ten random initialisations each reached a different value
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The monitoring quantity the review recommends in practice lacks the guarantee that belongs to the quantity it stands in for.
span.note: what this limits: using held-out predictive probability to decide that CAVI has converged: the review recommends it as a proxy while stating it is not guaranteed to increase monotonically, unlike the full ELBO
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
